source_visual_observations: Upper horizontal DC and lower horizontal BA; diagonal BC contains E; segment DE; CDE=74° and CD=CE.
audit.independent_solution: CD=CE makes triangle CDE isosceles, with angles D=E=74°. Thus DCE=180−148=32°. As AB is parallel to CD, angle B=32°, choice B.
